forward_state.scope: A ~220 m low-impact slow-traffic entry pilot at the southern edge of the Jing-Zhang Heritage Park active belt (K1-I01); the AI capability only suggests walking routes and aggregates anonymized flow counts.
inputs: public road network from the submitted roads layer
manual patrol counts (aggregate, no personal identifiers)
aggregate pedestrian flow counters (device-level data deleted after aggregation)
known_faults: no surveyed terrain; elevation assumptions are concept-grade
under-bridge space use rights not yet confirmed
night-time lighting permit not yet issued
forward_state.no_ai_baseline: the existing pedestrian path plus staffed enquiry remains available; paper maps and fixed wayfinding signage are unaffected by deactivation

rollback_path: deactivate digital flow counters and the route-suggestion display
restore always-on lighting and fixed wayfinding signage
publish the reversal notice on the public duty log
reversal_trigger: counter failure rate exceeds the pilot threshold
night-time safety complaints exceed the baseline threshold
under-bridge space use rights are rejected by the owner
residual_traces: device-level raw data is deleted within the retention window
the physical counter housings are removed or repurposed

acceptance.reproduction: a third party reproduces the pilot boundary from geometry/roads.geojson feature K1-I03-sandbox-safety-cross and the submitted site boundary in EPSG:4548
open_items: river blue-line verification (organizer-side data gap A-BOUNDARY-001)
accessibility assessment before any public exercise
